name: Mask Wall Edge Before Ceiling Spray
intent: Tape and paper the top of the wall along the ceiling line before any ceiling spray application. Prevents overspray from contaminating bare drywall walls (which would then need to be cleaned and re-primed). Only fires for spray methods — roll ceilings don't need wall edge protection because the roller doesn't atomize.

tasks.name: Mask Wall Edge for Ceiling Spray

doctrine: Wall edge masking is the ceiling painter's responsibility because the ceiling crew is on the ladder/scaffold first. Rate matches general per-LF masking (similar to baseboard masking at 200 LF/hr but slower because of overhead positioning). Removed during cleanup at the same per-LF rate (~275 LF/hr — pulling tape is faster than installing it). Height modifier applies because tall ceilings require ladder work.
